paragraphs: Chinena, father of R. Yanta, in R. Benayah's name: Jerusalem Talmud, beginning of Makom SheNahagu. Taanit, chapter 4, halakhah 2, has father of R. Nata; there, 4:5:7 [received halakhah 8], father of bar Yanta.
